restoration_notes.source_layout: Extract source/ into a separate checkout; paths inside source/ retain their original names.
restoration_steps: Start in a separate checkout; do not unzip into the live project without reviewing the map.
Use source/ for the original Zen artwork, metadata, scripts, shaders and tests.
Use reference/ for snapshots of the shared integration before archival. Port the Zen-specific hooks; do not overwrite newer shared scripts wholesale.
The recovered full profile predates the current asset manifests. Move restored Zen assets into assets/themes/zen_garden/, create its manifest and update every old/relative path.
Use reference/asset-migration-plan.json to translate references to shared fonts, schemas and other active assets moved during Step 3.
Restore providers, model/renderer hooks and tests before adding Zen to the selectable registry.
Reimport and validate all colors, stone/rake paths, centers, ponds and trees in both board sizes before exposing the theme.
restoration_notes.preservation: The versioned ZIP under preserved/ is a copy of the external archive; .gdignore and export exclusions keep it out of Godot imports and builds.

verification.exported_pack: 205 images, six OGG recordings, 212 import artifacts; no archive, Zen artwork, test fixture or orphan imports
